questions.question: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.passage: Slice up a tomato and compare it with the human heart. You will see that they look similar. Researchers say the chemicals ⓐ<u>made</u> from tomatoes are good for your heart and blood. ⓑ<u>Eating</u> tomatoes can lower your risk of heart disease. Look at the shape of a walnut. It is very similar to the shape of the human brain. A walnut is divided into two parts, just like the brain. Walnuts also have wrinkles, ⓒ<u>which</u> the brain has too. Studies ⓓ<u>showing</u> that walnuts help our brains stay healthy. They are also good for ⓔ<u>preventing</u> Alzheimer's disease.
questions.explanation: ⓓ가 포함된 문장에는 본동사가 없으므로 분사 showing이 아니라 본동사 show가 와야 합니다. (Studies show that ~)

questions.question: 다음 밑줄 친 관계대명사의 쓰임이 어법상 옳은 것은?
options: ① I have a friend who speaks five languages.
② This is the book what I bought.
③ He is the man which lives next door.
④ She met a boy whom can dance well.
⑤ I know a girl whose is very kind.
questions.explanation: 선행사 a friend가 사람이고 관계절에서 주어 역할을 하므로 주격 관계대명사 who가 적절합니다. 나머지는 관계대명사 선택/격이 틀립니다.

questions.question: 다음 우리말에 맞게 주어진 단어를 활용하여 문장을 완성하시오.
questions.passage:
나의 목표는 의사가 되는 것이다.
My goal is _________________. (be, a doctor)
questions.explanation: be동사의 보어 자리에 명사적 용법의 to부정사 'to be a doctor'를 씁니다.

questions.question: 밑줄의 빈칸 친 (A)와 문장에서의 역할이 같은 것은? (3점)
questions.passage:
No More Subtitles!

What Works for You?

There are hundreds of good tips out there, but everyone has their own way of learning. Find <u>(A)what keeps you motivated</u>, and then you will enjoy learning more. Remember, every language is hard at first, but a new language can make your world much bigger!
options: ① I don't believe what you told me.
② Her honesty is what I like about her.
③ What surprised me was Paul's behavior.
④ This is what I ought from the market.
⑤ The situation is different from what we expected.
questions.explanation: (A) ‘what keeps you motivated’는 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사 what이 이끄는 명사절로, 동사 Find의 목적어 역할을 한다. ①의 ‘what you told me’도 believe의 목적어 역할을 하는 관계대명사 what 명사절이므로 역할이 같다.
